description: issue #844: the CHECK-mode half of the checker/runtime agreement for `grid`'s arity. `grid` is Kind C, arity 0 (spec/geometry-module.md's `## grid`), so the parenthesized form is the only way to over-supply it — and the static checker must raise `ol-too-many-inputs` there at `stage: "semantic"`, gated on the active `geometry` profile. Its execute-mode twin is geometry/overlays/grid-too-many-inputs, which pins the identical code/params/span at `stage: "runtime"`: same call, same verdict, both stages.
